MappingFields.Name: UsId
MappingFields.Description: [Required] AFAS user code. Update mapping only executed when update toggle is enabled in connector configuration.

MappingFields.Name: BcCo
MappingFields.Description: Person number. Filled by the create/correlate script and stored in account data.

MappingFields.Name: EmAd
MappingFields.Description: E-mail. Required for OutSite to be enabled. If EmAd is empty, OutSite cannot be enabled.

MappingFields.Name: Site
MappingFields.Description: OutSite. EmAd is required for OutSite to be enabled. If EmAd is empty, OutSite cannot be enabled.

MappingFields.Name: MtCd
MappingFields.Description:
Mutation code. The scripts use code 1 when omitted.

0: block user and remove groups
1: update user
2: block user and keep groups
3: update user
4: change UsId (do not use, handled in update script)
5: change password (do not use)
6: unblock user
